column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah E99010: Liushih & Zhisui mengawal logistik Mokosh, jembatan
# hancur, lalu menyusun rencana merampok konvoi logistik Mangi Security.
# Tetap Inggris: Cliffwatch, Liushih, Zhisui, Dilu, Mokosh, Mangi Security, Commander,
# Groza, OTs-14, The Elmo, Doll, Neural cloud.
(The sky full of yellow sand was like rough sandpaper, rubbing against the steep rock walls and making a harsh sound.)
column2: (Langit yang penuh pasir kuning bagai kertas gosok kasar, menggerus dinding batu terjal dan menimbulkan suara yang memekakkan.)

column1: (At the bottom of this desolate canyon, a transport formation consisting of dozens of mechanical horses was moving forward under a heavy load.)
column2: (Di dasar kanyon yang gersang itu, satu formasi transpor berisi puluhan kuda mekanis bergerak maju dengan beban berat.)

column1: (Leading this team forward was the leader of Cliffwatch, Liushih. She was escorting Mokosh's logistics transport team.)
column2: (Yang memimpin regu ini adalah pemimpin Cliffwatch, Liushih. Dia sedang mengawal tim transpor logistik Mokosh.)

column1: (Unlike usual, Liushih currently only had Zhisui by her side, while the other Cliffwatch members had been sent by her to other settlements to help them consolidate their defenses.)
column2: (Berbeda dari biasanya, saat ini hanya Zhisui yang mendampingi Liushih, sementara anggota Cliffwatch lain dia kirim ke permukiman lain untuk membantu memperkuat pertahanan mereka.)

column1: Everyone, how is the battle situation now?
column2: Semuanya, bagaimana situasi pertempuran sekarang?

column1: (As the leader of Cliffwatch, Liushih couldn't appear on the front lines with her compatriots at this moment, so she naturally couldn't help but worry.)
column2: (Sebagai pemimpin Cliffwatch, Liushih saat ini tidak bisa berada di garis depan bersama rekan-rekannya, jadi wajar dia tidak bisa berhenti khawatir.)

column1: Don't worry! The enemy's attacks are weak and powerless. No matter how much firepower they deploy, they're just posturing paper tigers.
column2: Tenang saja! Serangan musuh lemah dan tak bertenaga. Sebanyak apa pun daya tembak yang mereka kerahkan, mereka cuma macan kertas yang berlagak.

column1: On the contrary, please make sure to deliver the supplies to Mokosh and that Commander.
column2: Sebaliknya, pastikan pasokannya sampai ke Mokosh dan Commander itu.

column1: We believe in you, Boss.
column2: Kami percaya padamu, Boss.

column1: Thank you everyone, I definitely will.
column2: Terima kasih semuanya, aku pasti melakukannya.

column1: (After questioning some details again and confirming that the rear battle situation was worry-free, Liushih finally ended the communication.)
column2: (Setelah menanyakan beberapa detail lagi dan memastikan situasi pertempuran di belakang tidak mengkhawatirkan, Liushih akhirnya menutup komunikasi.)

column1: Liushih just loves to worry. Believe in everyone.
column2: Liushih memang suka khawatir. Percayalah pada semuanya.

column1: Hehe, that's true.
column2: Hehe, benar juga.

column1: Let's hurry, Zhisui. The frontline situation is tense, the Commander must really need our assistance.
column2: Ayo cepat, Zhisui. Situasi garis depan tegang, Commander pasti sangat butuh bantuan kita.

column1: (Mentioning this, Zhisui showed a worried expression.)
column2: (Menyinggung soal itu, Zhisui menunjukkan wajah cemas.)

column1: I wonder if the other settlements still have enough supplies?
column2: Entah permukiman lain masih punya pasokan yang cukup atau tidak?

column1: Those settlements we passed by earlier... you saw them too. Let alone gathering extra supplies from them, Cliffwatch even needs to dispatch members to assist them...
column2: Permukiman yang kita lewati tadi... kau juga melihatnya. Jangan bicara soal mengumpulkan pasokan tambahan dari mereka, Cliffwatch malah harus mengirim anggota untuk membantu...

column1: Can we really complete the mission?
column2: Apa kita benar-benar bisa menyelesaikan misinya?

column1: (Mentioning this, Liushih also felt a wave of bitterness.)
column2: (Menyinggung soal itu, Liushih juga merasakan gelombang kepahitan.)

column1: We still have to go and see.
column2: Kita tetap harus pergi melihat sendiri.

column1: (However, after continuing forward for half an hour, Liushih's team had to stop.)
column2: (Namun, setelah melaju setengah jam lagi, regu Liushih harus berhenti.)

column1: (Looking at the broken bridge in front of her, Liushih frowned tightly.)
column2: (Menatap jembatan yang hancur di depannya, Liushih mengerutkan dahi dalam-dalam.)

column1: Um...
column2: Ehm...

column1: The road... has been blown up...
column2: Jalannya... sudah diledakkan...

column1: This bridge... I remember it's the key to reaching other settlements. Was it also blown up by Mangi Security's artillery fire?
column2: Jembatan ini... kalau tidak salah ini kunci untuk mencapai permukiman lain. Apa ini juga diledakkan artileri Mangi Security?

column1: This is the most critical main road in the route. If we detour to other routes...
column2: Ini jalan utama paling krusial di rute kita. Kalau memutar ke rute lain...

column1: (Hearing this, Liushih's Neural cloud rapidly calculated, but no matter which route or how the plan was optimized, there was no way to bring enough supplies and reach Mokosh at the agreed time.)
column2: (Mendengar itu, Neural cloud Liushih menghitung cepat, tapi rute mana pun dan seoptimal apa pun rencananya, tidak ada cara membawa pasokan yang cukup sekaligus tiba di Mokosh pada waktu yang dijanjikan.)

column1: What should we do...
column2: Bagaimana ini...

column1: (However, just then, Liushih heard a muffled explosion in the distance.)
column2: (Namun tepat saat itu, Liushih mendengar dentuman ledakan yang teredam dari kejauhan.)

column1: Everyone! Take cover immediately!
column2: Semuanya! Segera cari perlindungan!

column1: (Hearing Liushih's words, the logistics transport team immediately hid behind nearby cover, standing by in full readiness.)
column2: (Mendengar perintah Liushih, tim transpor logistik langsung bersembunyi di balik penutup terdekat, bersiaga penuh.)

column1: (After a while, the sound gradually quieted down. Liushih took the lead, riding Dilu out of the cover.)
column2: (Beberapa saat kemudian, suaranya perlahan mereda. Liushih maju paling depan, menunggangi Dilu keluar dari tempat berlindung.)

column1: Everyone stand by, I'll go check the situation.
column2: Semuanya bersiaga, aku akan memeriksa situasinya.

column1: You be careful too.
column2: Kau juga hati-hati.

column1: (Liushih nodded, then set off towards the direction of the explosion to check.)
column2: (Liushih mengangguk, lalu berangkat ke arah ledakan untuk memeriksa.)

column1: (She rode Dilu to a relatively high place, and then scouted with high-magnification binoculars.)
column2: (Dia menunggangi Dilu ke tempat yang relatif tinggi, lalu mengintai dengan binokular perbesaran tinggi.)

column1: (Soon, she found that about two or three kilometers away from her, a team of Mangi Security members was surrounding the wreckage of an armored vehicle, doing who knows what.)
column2: (Tak lama, dia menemukan sekitar dua atau tiga kilometer dari posisinya, satu regu anggota Mangi Security mengerumuni bangkai kendaraan lapis baja, entah sedang apa.)

column1: (After further magnifying the telescope's magnification, she found that the armored vehicle was sparking, and those Mangi Security members seemed to be arguing.)
column2: (Setelah menaikkan lagi perbesaran teleskopnya, dia melihat kendaraan lapis baja itu memercikkan bunga api, dan anggota Mangi Security itu sepertinya sedang berdebat.)

column1: This is... Mangi Security's logistics transport convoy?
column2: Ini... konvoi transpor logistik Mangi Security?

column1: (Liushih was stunned. She didn't expect that outside the frontline flames of war, the enemy's logistics supply line would appear in this location.)
column2: (Liushih terpaku. Dia tidak menyangka di luar kobaran perang garis depan, jalur pasokan logistik musuh muncul di lokasi ini.)

column1: Is this a trap laid by the enemy? Did the other side discover Mokosh's logistics route?
column2: Apa ini jebakan yang dipasang musuh? Apa pihak sana menemukan rute logistik Mokosh?

column1: No...
column2: Tidak...

column1: (Liushih pondered for a moment, she found that the logic didn't add up.)
column2: (Liushih berpikir sejenak, dan menemukan logikanya tidak masuk.)

column1: If that were really the case, then their armed forces should have made a move long ago, instead of exposing their own logistics supply line as well.
column2: Kalau memang begitu, pasukan bersenjata mereka seharusnya sudah bergerak sejak lama, bukan malah membuka jalur pasokan logistik mereka sendiri.

column1: And it looks like... that's a single convoy, did they get separated? Looking at the shape of the armored wreckage, it seems that artillery shells exploded during transport?
column2: Dan kelihatannya... itu konvoi tunggal, apa mereka terpisah? Dilihat dari bentuk bangkai lapis bajanya, sepertinya peluru artilerinya meledak saat diangkut?

column1: Wait a minute...
column2: Tunggu dulu...

column1: (Soon, Liushih found that this was not just one Mangi Security team. She slightly reduced the imaging scale and found that on the distant wasteland, there were very many Mangi Security convoys like this.)
column2: (Tak lama, Liushih menemukan ini bukan cuma satu regu Mangi Security. Dia sedikit memperkecil skala citranya dan menemukan di padang gersang yang jauh itu ada sangat banyak konvoi Mangi Security serupa.)

column1: (They were like swarms of little dots of light, forming loose formations and moving along several different trajectories across hundreds of square kilometers of wasteland.)
column2: (Mereka bagai kerumunan titik cahaya kecil, membentuk formasi longgar dan bergerak mengikuti beberapa jalur berbeda di padang gersang seluas ratusan kilometer persegi.)

column1: (And their direction was unified.)
column2: (Dan arah mereka seragam.)

column1: (However, just as she wanted to further investigate the source of those 'dots of light', she found her line of sight blocked by huge mountain peaks.)
column2: (Namun begitu dia ingin menyelidiki lebih jauh sumber 'titik cahaya' itu, garis pandangnya terhalang puncak-puncak gunung raksasa.)

column1: (If she wanted to investigate further, her current position obviously couldn't provide a good view.)
column2: (Kalau ingin menyelidiki lebih dalam, posisinya sekarang jelas tidak memberi pandangan yang baik.)

column1: (Liushih suppressed the urge to thoroughly investigate. Her years as a leader had taught her to keep her cool. What was most important right now was to digest this unexpected intelligence first.)
column2: (Liushih menahan dorongan untuk menyelidiki sampai tuntas. Pengalamannya bertahun-tahun sebagai pemimpin mengajarinya tetap tenang. Yang paling penting sekarang adalah mencerna dulu intel tak terduga ini.)

column1: (Returning to the main force, Liushih saw that nearly half of the warhorses' backs were empty—according to the original plan, they should be fully loaded with supplies and rushing to Mokosh.)
column2: (Kembali ke pasukan utama, Liushih melihat hampir separuh punggung kuda perangnya kosong—menurut rencana awal, semuanya seharusnya penuh muatan pasokan dan bergegas ke Mokosh.)

column1: (But currently the road is blown up, and detouring to other settlements will take extra time.)
column2: (Tapi sekarang jalannya sudah diledakkan, dan memutar ke permukiman lain akan menyita waktu tambahan.)

column1: (Liushih couldn't help but think—with the battle situation so tense, can she really collect enough supplies from other settlements?)
column2: (Liushih tak bisa berhenti berpikir—dengan situasi pertempuran setegang ini, apa dia benar-benar bisa mengumpulkan pasokan yang cukup dari permukiman lain?)

column1: (Liushih fell into deep thought—on one side is the distant Mangi Security logistics team, on the other side is the unloaded mechanical horse herd...)
column2: (Liushih tenggelam dalam pikiran—di satu sisi ada tim logistik Mangi Security di kejauhan, di sisi lain ada kawanan kuda mekanis tanpa muatan...)

column1: (Subsequently, a plan that had the best of both worlds, but was slightly dangerous, brewed and took shape in Liushih's Neural cloud.)
column2: (Setelah itu, sebuah rencana yang menguntungkan dua-duanya, tapi agak berbahaya, mengendap dan mengambil bentuk di Neural cloud Liushih.)

column1: Zhisui, I've figured out how to solve our supply problem.
column2: Zhisui, aku sudah tahu cara mengatasi masalah pasokan kita.

column1: (She flashed Zhisui a serene smile.)
column2: (Dia melempar senyum tenang kepada Zhisui.)

column1: (A little while later, having sorted everything out, Liushih dialed the Commander's comms.)
column2: (Beberapa saat kemudian, setelah semuanya beres, Liushih menghubungi komunikasi Commander.)

column1: Miss Liushih, do you have something for the Commander?
column2: Miss Liushih, ada urusan dengan Commander?

column1: He's in a meeting right now. If there's any situation, I can pass the message along.
column2: Beliau sedang rapat. Kalau ada situasi, aku bisa menyampaikan pesannya.

column1: Ah, Miss Groza, there's something I'd like to coordinate with the Commander.
column2: Ah, Miss Groza, ada hal yang ingin kukoordinasikan dengan Commander.

column1: But, telling you should be fine too.
column2: Tapi, disampaikan padamu juga seharusnya tidak masalah.

column1: (Soon, Liushih repeats her findings and plans.)
column2: (Tak lama, Liushih mengulangi temuan dan rencananya.)

column1: (Miss Groza in the communication seemed to be hesitating about something, but soon, her expression returned to normal.)
column2: (Miss Groza di komunikasi itu sepertinya ragu soal sesuatu, tapi tak lama ekspresinya kembali normal.)

column1: I know a suitable candidate for this matter, I'll transfer the line to her.
column2: Aku tahu orang yang tepat untuk urusan ini, akan kualihkan sambungannya ke dia.

column1: (As soon as Groza finished speaking, a new communication signal connected in.)
column2: (Begitu Groza selesai bicara, sinyal komunikasi baru tersambung masuk.)

column1: (A face extremely similar to Miss Groza appears in the communication video.)
column2: (Sebuah wajah yang sangat mirip Miss Groza muncul di video komunikasi.)

column1: I understand the situation. You want to attack the enemy's logistics, seize their supplies, and then return them to Mokosh.
column2: Aku paham situasinya. Kau ingin menyerang logistik musuh, merebut pasokan mereka, lalu membawanya balik ke Mokosh.

column1: It's a good idea. Let the third-generation Doll squads execute the specific mission.
column2: Ide yang bagus. Biar regu Doll generasi ketiga yang menjalankan misi rincinya.

column1: Miss OTs-14, could you please listen to my plan?
column2: Miss OTs-14, boleh kau dengarkan dulu rencanaku?

column1: ...Speak.
column2: ...Bicara.

column1: Specifically, I hope Miss OTs-14 can provide fire support at critical moments.
column2: Konkretnya, aku berharap Miss OTs-14 bisa memberi dukungan tembakan di momen-momen krusial.

column1: I will take Dilu and the other mechanical horses to approach the enemy, providing detailed reconnaissance intelligence and the most suitable timing for crossfire.
column2: Aku akan membawa Dilu dan kuda mekanis lainnya mendekati musuh, menyediakan intel pengintaian yang rinci dan waktu paling tepat untuk tembakan silang.

column1: After you make your move, I will control the idle mechanical horses to take away as much baggage as possible, and then detour back to Mokosh.
column2: Setelah kalian bergerak, aku akan mengendalikan kuda mekanis yang kosong untuk mengangkut muatan sebanyak mungkin, lalu memutar balik ke Mokosh.

column1: (OTs-14 pondered for a moment, then she calmly pointed out the inadequate parts of Liushih's plan.)
column2: (OTs-14 berpikir sejenak, lalu dengan tenang menunjuk bagian-bagian rencana Liushih yang belum memadai.)

column1: The overall arrangement is coherent. The third-generation Doll squad can indeed provide firepower far exceeding other Elmo teams, but the problem lies in the same place.
column2: Susunan keseluruhannya runtut. Regu Doll generasi ketiga memang bisa memberi daya tembak yang jauh melebihi regu Elmo lain, tapi masalahnya justru ada di titik yang sama.

column1: After engaging in combat, we are not confident that we won't accidentally injure you and your mechanical horse herd—as far as I know, those are very expensive specialized vehicles for mountain environments.
column2: Setelah pertempuran dimulai, kami tidak yakin bisa menghindari melukaimu dan kawanan kuda mekanismu—sejauh yang kutahu, itu kendaraan khusus lingkungan pegunungan yang sangat mahal.

column1: Do you have the ability to ensure the safety of yourself and the mechanical horse herd?
column2: Apa kau punya kemampuan menjamin keselamatan dirimu dan kawanan kuda mekanis itu?

column1: (Hearing Miss OTs-14's question, Liushih smiled slightly.)
column2: (Mendengar pertanyaan Miss OTs-14, Liushih tersenyum kecil.)

column1: Please rest assured.
column2: Tenang saja.

column1: My ability is—I am very rich.
column2: Kemampuanku adalah—aku sangat kaya.

column1: (Hearing this, even OTs-14, who had fought on the battlefield for a long time, couldn't help but frown tightly.)
column2: (Mendengar itu, bahkan OTs-14 yang sudah lama bertempur di medan perang tak bisa menahan diri untuk mengerutkan dahi dalam-dalam.)

column1: No matter how much it costs, I will repair them!
column2: Berapa pun biayanya, aku akan memperbaiki mereka!

column1: Of course, I will also do my best not to let them get hurt.
column2: Tentu, aku juga akan berusaha sebisa mungkin supaya mereka tidak terluka.

column1: ...As you wish.
column2: ...Sesuai maumu.

column1: Liushih, while I haven't gone far yet, I have to ask you one more thing—
column2: Liushih, sebelum aku pergi jauh, aku harus menanyakan satu hal lagi—

column1: Are you sure you want to execute such a dangerous mission by yourself?
column2: Kau yakin mau menjalankan misi sebahaya itu sendirian?

column1: Although I promised you just now, still...
column2: Meski tadi aku sudah setuju, tetap saja...

column1: It's okay, Zhisui.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, Zhisui.

column1: After I leave, escorting the entire transport convoy alone won't be an easy task for you either.
column2: Setelah aku pergi, mengawal seluruh konvoi transpor sendirian juga bukan tugas mudah untukmu.

column1: Moreover, Mokosh is currently surrounded tightly. I also need you to use your abilities to find a way to deliver the supplies to the Commander.
column2: Lebih dari itu, Mokosh sekarang dikepung rapat. Aku juga butuh kau memakai kemampuanmu untuk mencari jalan mengantar pasokannya ke Commander.

column1: That's true, but I still can't help worrying about you...
column2: Benar, tapi aku tetap tidak bisa berhenti mengkhawatirkanmu...

column1: If it weren't an emergency, I wouldn't let you act so recklessly.
column2: Kalau bukan keadaan darurat, aku tidak akan membiarkanmu bertindak segegabah itu.

column1: Believe in me, Zhisui. I'm not fighting alone either.
column2: Percayalah padaku, Zhisui. Aku juga tidak bertarung sendirian.

column1: Dilu and the other mechanical horse herds are all by my side.
column2: Dilu dan kawanan kuda mekanis lainnya ada di sisiku.

column1: (Liushih rode Dilu, gently stroking its neck.)
column2: (Liushih menunggangi Dilu, mengusap lembut lehernya.)

column1: (And behind her, dozens of mechanical warhorses silently followed Dilu's pace.)
column2: (Dan di belakangnya, puluhan kuda perang mekanis mengikuti langkah Dilu tanpa suara.)

column1: Understood, leave the commander to me, I'll figure something out.
column2: Dimengerti, serahkan urusan commander padaku, akan kucari jalannya.

column1: But our comms cannot be cut off, if you run into danger, tell me!
column2: Tapi komunikasi kita tidak boleh terputus, kalau kau kena bahaya, beri tahu aku!

column1: No problem.
column2: Tidak masalah.

column1: (Then the communication ended, and Liushih showed a hint of fatigue.)
column2: (Lalu komunikasi itu berakhir, dan Liushih memperlihatkan sedikit rasa lelah.)

column1: Haha, I have a bit of a headache...
column2: Haha, kepalaku agak pusing...

column1: Was I acting a bit too tough in front of Zhisui just now?
column2: Apa tadi aku terlalu berlagak kuat di depan Zhisui?

column1: (Liushih took away most of the unloaded mechanical warhorses, which is the key to the plan.)
column2: (Liushih membawa sebagian besar kuda perang mekanis yang kosong, dan itulah kunci rencananya.)

column1: (Although Dilu can command other warhorses, the route Liushih is on is very close to the frontline battlefield, and a large amount of messy electromagnetic signals severely interfered with the communication between Dilu and the other warhorses.)
column2: (Meski Dilu bisa mengomando kuda perang lain, rute yang dilalui Liushih sangat dekat dengan medan tempur garis depan, dan sinyal elektromagnetik kacau dalam jumlah besar mengganggu berat komunikasi antara Dilu dan kuda perang lainnya.)

column1: (Liushih had to manually access Dilu's system and personally maintain the communication between Dilu and the other warhorses—every step she took brought a massive Neural cloud burden to Liushih, as the data she had to process was voluminous.)
column2: (Liushih harus mengakses sistem Dilu secara manual dan menjaga sendiri komunikasi antara Dilu dan kuda perang lainnya—setiap langkah yang dia ambil membebani Neural cloud-nya secara masif, karena data yang harus dia proses sangat banyak.)

column1: (However, these difficulties would not affect Liushih's determination to execute the mission.)
column2: (Namun kesulitan-kesulitan itu tidak akan menggoyahkan tekad Liushih menjalankan misinya.)

column1: Miss OTs-14, I've more or less figured out the enemy's logistics transportation pattern.
column2: Miss OTs-14, aku kurang lebih sudah memahami pola transportasi logistik musuh.

column1: The visual data shared by the mechanical warhorses shows that Mangi Security's convoys are basically advancing from north to south, with an average speed of 50 to 60 kilometers per hour.
column2: Data visual yang dibagikan kuda perang mekanis menunjukkan konvoi Mangi Security pada dasarnya bergerak dari utara ke selatan, dengan kecepatan rata-rata 50 sampai 60 kilometer per jam.

column1: Each group is fixedly paired with heavily armed armored vehicles and mobile motorcycle units, accompanied by armed drones.
column2: Setiap kelompok selalu dipasangkan dengan kendaraan lapis baja bersenjata berat dan unit motor mobil, disertai drone bersenjata.

column1: The transport convoy driving right in the middle, surrounded by such tight protection, is like the relationship between an aircraft carrier and destroyers.
column2: Konvoi transpor yang berjalan tepat di tengah, dikelilingi perlindungan seketat itu, mirip hubungan kapal induk dengan kapal perusaknya.

column1: Mhm, but judging from the visual intel you shared, the number of these well-trained logistics troops is very small, and their strike range is too scattered.
column2: Mhm, tapi dari intel visual yang kau bagikan, jumlah pasukan logistik terlatih itu sangat sedikit, dan jangkauan serang mereka terlalu tersebar.

column1: Under these circumstances, the cost of taking action is too high, and the return is too low.
column2: Dalam keadaan seperti ini, biaya bertindaknya terlalu tinggi, dan hasilnya terlalu kecil.

column1: The Elmo cannot easily expose its position. Without a high-value tactical target, I would advise you to abandon this operation.
column2: The Elmo tidak boleh sembarangan membuka posisinya. Tanpa target taktis bernilai tinggi, aku menyarankanmu membatalkan operasi ini.

column1: You're absolutely right, but...
column2: Kau benar sekali, tapi...

column1: (Liushih lowered her head in thought. She felt something was wrong, so she organized her thoughts and explained them to OTs-14.)
column2: (Liushih menunduk berpikir. Dia merasa ada yang tidak beres, jadi dia menata pikirannya dan menjelaskannya kepada OTs-14.)

column1: Because of this, there is a severe mismatch between supply and demand between the frontlines and the rear.
column2: Justru karena itu, ada ketimpangan berat antara pasokan dan kebutuhan di garis depan dan di belakang.

column1: The offensive ahead is very fierce, and the frontline is stretched very long. If there are only these scattered transport convoys, they definitely won't be enough to fill the frontline's consumption...
column2: Serangan di depan sangat ganas, dan garis depannya terentang sangat panjang. Kalau hanya ada konvoi transpor yang tersebar seperti ini, jelas tidak akan cukup menutup konsumsi garis depan...

column1: I know what you mean.
column2: Aku paham maksudmu.

column1: If Mangi Security's logistics are truly this sparse, then deploying that level of firepower right at the beginning of the war is extremely counterintuitive militarily.
column2: Kalau logistik Mangi Security benar-benar setipis ini, mengerahkan daya tembak sebesar itu di awal perang sangat berlawanan dengan nalar militer.

column1: We haven't discovered the real logistics team.
column2: Kita belum menemukan tim logistik yang sebenarnya.

column1: Yes, we haven't grasped the specific situation of the enemy's logistics yet.
column2: Benar, kita belum memegang gambaran konkret logistik musuh.

column1: But as long as I can capture more information... there might be an opportunity worth striking at.
column2: Tapi selama aku bisa menangkap lebih banyak informasi... mungkin ada peluang yang layak diserang.

column1: Simply put, I need to continue delving deeper into the enemy's activity range to obtain more reconnaissance intel.
column2: Singkatnya, aku perlu terus masuk lebih dalam ke wilayah gerak musuh untuk mendapat intel pengintaian tambahan.

column1: (OTs-14 in the communication frowned tightly.)
column2: (OTs-14 di komunikasi itu mengerutkan dahi dalam-dalam.)

column1: I need to remind you—your current position is already very far forward, and the risk of being discovered by the enemy is very high.
column2: Aku perlu mengingatkanmu—posisimu sekarang sudah sangat jauh ke depan, dan risiko ditemukan musuh sangat tinggi.

column1: Rashly going deep will not necessarily bring intelligence, it will only make your situation more dangerous.
column2: Menerobos lebih dalam secara gegabah belum tentu membawa intel, hanya membuat situasimu lebih berbahaya.

column1: But this is a reconnaissance mission, isn't it?
column2: Tapi ini misi pengintaian, bukan?

column1: Please rest assured, I have a lot of confidence in Dilu's performance.
column2: Tenang saja, aku sangat percaya pada performa Dilu.

column1: (Looking at Liushih's determined eyes, OTs-14 ponders for a moment. Then, she decides to trust Liushih's judgment.)
column2: (Menatap mata Liushih yang penuh tekad, OTs-14 berpikir sejenak. Lalu, dia memutuskan memercayai penilaian Liushih.)

column1: ...Act carefully, don't be rash.
column2: ...Bertindak hati-hati, jangan gegabah.

column1: (For supplies, do we really have to reach out to our own people?)
column2: (Demi pasokan, apa kita benar-benar harus mengulurkan tangan ke orang-orang kita sendiri?)
